items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: me and T-Bo, we got back together... made up a little band... Jim Crow, you got his name? And we had him on Chani Bar.

ctx.x: Come on, give me a right. What's it? Oh, me and T-Bo, we got back together, you know. And we just made up a little band, you know, like that. Six-piece band, you know. Who was with you? Who was with you? Well, Dr. Chani got five Chani come with us. We got Chani, you know. Eddie, Eddie, Eddie, and Eddie, Eddie, and Eddie, Eddie, and Eddie, Eddie, and Eddie, Jim Crow, you got his name? And we had him on Chani Bar. And we had Alcee, and myself, and T-Bo. Did I say Chani? Yeah. Yeah, Chani on drums then. Cornet?…
Ask him if this was before he was with Amos Riley or Amos Riley.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: He used to play with us after Freddie Babu.

ctx.x: Well, what about, uh, who did George Lewis work with other than him?

So, who did George Lewis work with in them times? He's a kid. He's a kid. He's a kid when he's coming out. My dear George worked- worked with me more than any band ever worked with. Now, of course, he'd been working with a different band, but now he got the band of his own. Used to work with Butter Petit too with me. That's how we worked with Kid Howard. And then I came to work with Kid Howard. Wasn't he working with Kid Howard once? And then Jim Crow. You got his name too? Oh yeah, I know him. He used to play…
Ask him about Albert Martin. How about Albert Martin?

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Jim Crow, and I think Chester Zardes. I'll ask him, where did he know Wilman Bro?

ctx.x: You say, wasn't nobody at the funeral much.
Jim Crow, and I think Chester Zardes. I'll ask him, where did he know Wilman Bro?

He said, why did you know Wilman Bro? Wilman Bro? Wilman Bro, he came from Central 5. He used to play with us, you know, with three and four piece bands. He never played with no big bands. He was a good bass player. Ask him what else for him. He used to play tambour and cornet and violin. He got a whole lot of cash in there around here. I don't know if he's like, you know. Madeline, huh? Yeah.
